result:
All checks pass, and the pre-existing warnings are unrelated to this change. Both `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` are green.

I fixed the open-redirect vulnerability in `app/Http/Controllers/Auth/LoginController.ts:12` by adding a `resolveSafeRedirect()` helper that only accepts single-leading-slash, same-app paths — rejecting absolute URLs (no leading `/`), protocol-relative URLs (`//...`), and backslash variants (`/\...`), falling back to `/dashboard` otherwise. `store()` now routes both the validated body's `redirect` and the raw query-string fallback through this helper before calling `this.redirect(...)`. I added `tests/LoginController.test.ts` covering: valid same-app redirect, no-redirect default, absolute URL, protocol-relative, backslash variant, and wrong-password-with-malicious-redirect (still 422, no session). All 8 project tests pass, `bun run typecheck` is clean, and `bunx guren check` shows no new issues.
